SWZ.note: Only a call for ethical AI use; no rule or authority on AI harms.
No government body is stated to use an AI system.

facts.fact: Principal Secretary Phesheya Dube of the Ministry of ICT said the ministry is currently drafting Eswatini's national AI strategy.

SWZ.note: A new AI research group at RSTP is named but no model, dataset or AI computing.
Training was for parliamentarians, not civil servants.
One workshop for MPs; no public programme or survey.
RSTP only hosts the workshop; no programme or tenants stated.
